description: FoxESS inverters with battery storage, Modbus RTU over RS485 and Modbus TCP: status, PV, grid, battery, BMS, energy counters, remote control and time-period scheduling

sources.title: FOX commercial inverter Modbus interface definition description

source: FoxESS, FOX commercial inverter Modbus definition V1.05.04.00 (2025-12-15)
notes: Gains in the document are divisors: a gain of 10 on a voltage means the register holds the voltage ×10, so the map uses a scale of 0.1.

The document does not state the byte order, the word order or the serial settings. 32-bit values are assumed to have the high register first, and 9600 baud, 8N1 is what integrators report for the H3 series; neither comes from the document.

The model list of the public document (table 1-1) is empty, so which models and firmware versions apply is not stated here. Registers and ranges marked in the document with an asterisk, or named for a model (H3 Smart, H3 Pro, KH, 812), only exist on those models.

Per-string registers are given for 24 strings and 24 MPPTs, and per-battery registers for 32 slaves of each of the two BMS; the document says that the host reads only the number of channels reported in 'Number of strings' and 'Number of slaves'.
Registers 45002, 45003 and 45005 are write-only in the document.
Bit meanings of the BMS fault registers are not described in the document.
